raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Adds a MI35x nightly accuracy gate for Muse Spark Open that covers both FP4 cells of the cookbook's MI355X / Low Latency recipe:

- Test: `test/registered/amd/accuracy/mi35x/test_muse_spark_open_eval_mi35x.py`
- Suite: `nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open`
- Job: `nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open` on `linux-mi35x-gpu-8` (TP4), 21600 s per-file cap

The test has one class per checkpoint, each with its own server and the recipe's flags (TP4/EP4, aiter attention at page size 16, `MUSE_MOE_BACKEND=flydsl`, DFlash2 with a Triton draft-attention backend, muse parsers):

- MXFP4: `amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4`
- NVFP4: `meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4` with `--quantization quark_mxfp4`, which requantizes to MXFP4 at load

Each server runs full-split GSM8K through sgl-eval (thinking on, `reasoning_effort=xhigh`, 32768 max tokens, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95) and 100 MMMU samples.

## Depends on

- [#44530](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44530), for the model code and `3rdparty/amd/muse_spark/apply_aiter_patches.sh`. This PR stays in draft until it lands.
- The Muse Spark aiter patches applying to the aiter that `docker/rocm.Dockerfile` pins on `main` (`2bb5491`). They were validated against `4ad9983`. Against `2bb5491`, `04-aiter-muse-moe-flydsl.patch` applies, but the aiter half of `03-plan-b-aiter-unified-attention-3d.patch` does not (`aiter/ops/triton/attention/unified_attention.py:293`; that file has been refactored since). I did not check `01-aiter-fix-page-scatter-vm-fault.patch`, which targets the composable_kernel submodule. Until 03 applies, the job's patch step fails.

## Why

On HIP, `muse_spark` dispatches to a separate ROCm implementation (`sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark`) that no CI covers. The NVFP4 cell takes a different load path from the MXFP4 one, so it gets its own server and gates. MMMU is included because the model is multimodal and the image path through the ROCm implementation is otherwise untested.

## Notes for the reviewer

- **Aiter patches:** the job applies them to the CI image before the test, as the #44530 README describes for plain ROCm images. The Day-0 image has them baked in. So the nightly also fails when the patches stop applying to the pinned aiter.
- **Thresholds:**
  - GSM8K 0.93 and the sampling settings come from the B300 Muse Spark test in #44530.
  - MMMU 0.50 is a placeholder with no AMD measurement behind it.
  - DFlash2 accept length is reported in the step summary but not gated.
- **Runner time:** it is one job because a single 8-GPU runner serves both checkpoints one after the other, at roughly 4 h.

## Test plan

Not run on hardware yet. Once #44530 lands and the aiter patches apply, I will dispatch the job on all three images, set the MMMU threshold from the measured score, and post the runs here before marking this ready.

- The workflow parses with PyYAML, and the new job is in the `job_select` options and in `check-all-jobs.needs`.
- The test file compiles and is formatted with black/isort.

@@ -2295,6 +2297,70 @@ jobs:
           echo "$(<github_summary.md )" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
           exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE:-0}
 
+  # ==============================================================================
+  # 4-GPU Muse Spark Open MXFP4 + NVFP4 (MI35x only - MXFP4 needs gfx95x)
+  # ==============================================================================
+
+  nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open:
+    name: ${{ format('nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open ({0}, linux-mi35x-gpu-8)', matrix.rocm_version) }}
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        rocm_version: ${{ fromJson(inputs.rocm_version && inputs.rocm_version != 'all' && format('["{0}"]', inputs.rocm_version) || '["rocm10", "rocm724", "rocm720"]') }}
+    if: (github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' || github.event_name == 'pull_request') && (!(inputs.job_filter || inputs.job_select) || (inputs.job_filter || inputs.job_select) == 'all' || contains(format(',{0},', inputs.job_filter || inputs.job_select), ',nightly-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open,'))
+    runs-on: linux-mi35x-gpu-8

+        uses: actions/checkout@v4

+          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}
+
+      - name: Ensure VRAM is clear
+        run: bash scripts/ci/amd/ensure_vram_clear.sh rocm
+
+      - name: Setup docker (${{ matrix.rocm_version }})
+        run: |
+          touch github_summary.md
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_start_container.sh --rocm-version ${{ matrix.rocm_version }}
+        env:
+          GITHUB_WORKSPACE: ${{ github.workspace }}
+          ENABLE_CACHE_HOST: "1"
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: |
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_install_dependency.sh --skip-test-time-deps
+          # Install tabulate for run_suite.py (missing in MI35x container)
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh pip install tabulate
+
+      # The recipe's aiter attention and FlyDSL experts need the Muse Spark
+      # aiter patches, which the Day-0 image bakes in and the CI image does
+      # not. The script fails if a patch no longer applies to the pinned aiter.
+      - name: Apply Muse Spark aiter patches
+        run: |
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w /sglang-checkout \
+            bash 3rdparty/amd/muse_spark/apply_aiter_patches.sh
+
+      - name: Check model cache space
+        run: |
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w /sglang-checkout \
+            bash scripts/ci/amd/check_hf_cache_space.sh \
+            amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4 500
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w /sglang-checkout \
+            bash scripts/ci/amd/check_hf_cache_space.sh \
+            meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 500
+
+      # Both FP4 cells of the MI355X recipe, one server each: the Quark MXFP4
+      # export, then the NVFP4 checkpoint requantized to MXFP4 at load.
+      - name: Accuracy Test MI35x ROCm (4-GPU Muse Spark Open MXFP4 + NVFP4)
+        timeout-minutes: 420
+        run: |
+          > github_summary.md
+          bash scripts/ci/amd/amd_ci_exec.sh -w /sglang-checkout/test \
+            -e GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY="/sglang-checkout/github_summary.md" \
+            python3 run_suite.py --hw amd --suite nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open --nightly --timeout-per-file 21600 ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.continue_on_error) && '--continue-on-error' || '' }} || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?

@@ -0,0 +1,227 @@
+"""MI35x Muse Spark Open GSM8K + MMMU Accuracy Test (4-GPU, TP=4)
+
+Tests Meta's Muse Spark Open (816B total / ~42B active multimodal MoE) on both
+FP4 cells of the cookbook's MI355X / Low Latency recipe:
+
+  * MXFP4: amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4, AMD's Quark export,
+    detected from its config.
+  * NVFP4: meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4 loaded directly with
+    ``--quantization quark_mxfp4``, which requantizes the weights to MXFP4 while
+    loading. Same kernels at serve time, but a separate load path with its own
+    numerics, so it gets its own server and its own gates.
+
+Both share the rest of the recipe: TP4/EP4, aiter attention at page size 16,
+FlyDSL experts, DFlash2 speculative decoding with a Triton draft-attention
+backend, and the muse reasoning and tool-call parsers.
+
+On HIP, ``sglang.srt.models.muse_spark`` dispatches to the separate ROCm
+implementation in ``sglang.srt.rocm_muse_spark``, and the recipe depends on
+aiter patches from ``3rdparty/amd/muse_spark`` (a CK batch-prefill VM-fault fix
+and the FlyDSL Muse MoE kernels) that the Day-0 image bakes in. The workflow
+job applies them to the CI image before this file runs, so a nightly also
+catches the patches falling out of step with the pinned aiter.
+
+Each checkpoint's server runs both evals, so they gate the exact configuration
+users deploy:
+
+  * GSM8K, through sgl-eval (zero-shot chat, thinking on, reasoning_effort
+    xhigh, 32768 max tokens, temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95). The reasoning parser
+    keeps the trace out of ``content``. These are the settings and the 0.93
+    gate of the B300 Muse Spark GSM8K test on the same checkpoint family.
+  * MMMU (100 samples), because Muse Spark Open is multimodal and the vision
+    path through the ROCm implementation is otherwise untested.
+
+MXFP4 needs gfx95x, so this is MI35x-only.
+
+Registry: nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open suite
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.test.accuracy_test_runner import (
+    AccuracyTestResult,
+    write_accuracy_github_summary,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.run_eval import run_eval
+from sglang.test.sgl_eval_utils import run_sgl_eval
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    is_in_ci,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    write_github_step_summary,
+)
+
+# Register for AMD CI - MI35x Muse Spark Open accuracy (~4 h: two ~450 GB
+# checkpoints, each loaded and then run through a full-split thinking GSM8K and
+# 100 MMMU samples)
+register_amd_ci(
+    est_time=14400,
+    suite="nightly-amd-4-gpu-mi35x-muse-spark-open",
+    nightly=True,
+)
+
+DRAFT_MODEL_PATH = "RadixArk/Muse-Spark-Open-DFlash2"
+TP_SIZE = 4
+
+GSM8K_THRESHOLD = 0.93
+# Provisional: there is no AMD MMMU measurement for this model yet. Replace
+# with the measured score minus 0.05 once the first nightly reports one.
+MMMU_THRESHOLD = 0.50
+
+# Fetching and loading a ~450 GB checkpoint against a cold cache is what this
+# budget has to cover.
+SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT = 5400
+
+# The cookbook's MI355X / Low Latency cell, shared by both checkpoints.
+RECIPE_ARGS = [
+    "--tp-size",
+    str(TP_SIZE),
+    "--ep-size",
+    str(TP_SIZE),
+    "--attention-backend",
+    "aiter",
+    "--page-size",
+    "16",
+    "--mem-fraction-static",
+    "0.85",
+    "--speculative-algorithm",
+    "DFLASH",
+    "--speculative-draft-model-path",
+    DRAFT_MODEL_PATH,
+    "--speculative-draft-attention-backend",
+    "triton",
+    "--speculative-num-draft-tokens",
+    "8",
+    "--reasoning-parser",
+    "muse",
+    "--tool-call-parser",
+    "muse",
+    # Not part of the cookbook cell; covers weight loading on a checkpoint
+    # this large, with no effect on numerics.
+    "--watchdog-timeout",
+    "1200",
+]
+SERVER_ENV = {
+    "SGLANG_USE_AITER": "1",
+    "SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN": "1",
+    "MUSE_MOE_BACKEND": "flydsl",
+}
+
+
+class _MuseSparkOpenEvalMI35x:
+    """GSM8K + MMMU for one checkpoint, from one server. Not a TestCase itself,
+    so unittest only collects the per-checkpoint subclasses."""
+
+    model_path: str
+    quant_label: str
+    extra_args: list = []
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model_path,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=SERVER_LAUNCH_TIMEOUT,
+            other_args=RECIPE_ARGS + cls.extra_args,
+            env=SERVER_ENV,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def _record(self, dataset, score, threshold, latency=None):
+        passed = score >= threshold
+        write_accuracy_github_summary(
+            f"Muse Spark Open {self.quant_label} (MI35x)",
+            dataset,
+            [
+                AccuracyTestResult(
+                    model=self.model_path,
+                    dataset=dataset,
+                    passed=passed,
+                    score=score,
+                    baseline_accuracy=threshold,
+                    error=None if passed else "below baseline",
+                    latency=latency,
+                    variant=f"TP4+EP4+{self.quant_label}+aiterAttn+FlyDSL+DFlash2",
+                )
+            ],
+        )
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(score, threshold)
+
+    def _report_accept_length(self):
+        # Reported, not gated: no AMD measurement exists yet to set a floor.
+        response = requests.get(f"{self.base_url}/server_info", timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        states = response.json().get("internal_states") or [{}]
+        accept_length = states[0].get("avg_spec_accept_length")
+        print(f"{self.quant_label} avg_spec_accept_length={accept_length}")
+        if is_in_ci() and accept_length is not None:
+            write_github_step_summary(
+                f"{self.quant_label} DFlash2 avg_spec_accept_length: "
+                f"{accept_length:.4f}\n"
+            )
+
+    def test_a_gsm8k(self):
+        """Full-split GSM8K through sgl-eval with thinking on."""
+        requests.get(self.base_url + "/flush_cache", timeout=60)
+        metrics = run_sgl_eval(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                base_url=self.base_url,
+                model=self.model_path,
+                eval_name="gsm8k",
+                num_examples=None,
+                num_threads=64,
+                max_tokens=32768,
+                temperature=1.0,
+                top_p=0.95,
+                seed=42,
+                sgl_eval_thinking=True,
+                reasoning_effort="xhigh",
+            )
+        )
+        self._report_accept_length()
+        self._record("gsm8k", metrics["score"], GSM8K_THRESHOLD, metrics.get("latency"))
+
+    def test_b_mmmu(self):
+        """100-sample MMMU, so the image path is exercised on ROCm."""
+        requests.get(self.base_url + "/flush_cache", timeout=60)
+        metrics = run_eval(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                base_url=self.base_url,
+                model=self.model_path,
+                eval_name="mmmu",
+                num_examples=100,
+                num_threads=64,
+                max_tokens=32768,
+                reasoning_effort="xhigh",
+            )
+        )
+        self._record("mmmu", metrics["score"], MMMU_THRESHOLD)
+
+
+class TestMuseSparkOpenMxfp4EvalMI35x(_MuseSparkOpenEvalMI35x, unittest.TestCase):
+    """Cookbook MI355X / MXFP4 cell: AMD's Quark MXFP4 export."""
+
+    model_path = "amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4"
+    quant_label = "MXFP4"
+
+
+class TestMuseSparkOpenNvfp4EvalMI35x(_MuseSparkOpenEvalMI35x, unittest.TestCase):
+    """Cookbook MI355X / NVFP4 cell: the NVFP4 checkpoint requantized to MXFP4
+    at load."""
+
+    model_path = "meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-NVFP4"
+    quant_label = "NVFP4"
+    extra_args = ["--quantization", "quark_mxfp4"]
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
